text:
incident-bot: URGENT: runtime-prod eu-west1 - error budget alert threshold crossed (5xx spike) — paging oncall. incident id INC-2026-1919990001
Jules: I'm awake, oncall ack. seeing ~2.6% 5xx across eu-west1, started 00:05UTC. no deploys in last hour according to deploy-bot.
DevOps-bot: recent deploys: no runtime-service deploys in last 60m. autoscaler events: scale-up at 23:58UTC.
Hana: initial check: traffic pattern shows a short-lived spike from a webhook-heavy partner. backends returning 502 intermittently. could be upstream timeouts.
Omar: I'll open a temporary rule to increase proxy connection limits and extend backend timeouts by 2s. doing the change now.
Sree: adding ephemeral traffic shaping to throttle suspect partner IP ranges to protect global pool.
Jules: mitigation steps applied: connection limit +20%, backend timeout +2s, partner throttled. 5xx dropped to 0.4% in 6 minutes. marking mitigated -> monitoring.
incident-bot: incident status: mitigated. please collect notes for post-incident review.
Jules: notes for post-incident: 1) noisy 5xx alert caused PD page while this could have been transient; 2) lack of a quick RCA dashboard made root cause slower to confirm; 3) deploy suppression would have helped if it were a deploy.
Hana: for alert tuning proposal: move 5xx page rule to require both relative and absolute conditions: absolute >0.7% for 5m AND relative increase over baseline (rolling 1h) by >2.5x. add `on:deploy` annotation suppression for 10m.
Omar: agree. also suggest a staging of rules: 1) page to augmentation channel (no PD) for first 30m after change, 2) if sustained -> PD. allows us to test without waking everyone.
Sree: dashboard plan for retrospectives: build `grafana: incident-retro-runtime` with panels targeted at quick RCA. panel list draft:
- Summary row: incident status, duration, impacted regions (text + small stat panels)
- Golden signals row: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, availability (single stat + sparkline)
- Traffic heatmap: requests by region + model (heatmap)
- Error taxonomy: 4xx vs 5xx vs upstream 502/504 breakdown (stacked bar)
- Backend health: active connections, queue length, worker utilization, socket errors (timeseries)
- Deploy & events lane: annotation strip of deploys, autoscaler events, and manual incident notes
- Alerts fired (noise-meter): count of alert firings last 24h, top 5 firing rules (table)
- Drilldown links: each panel will have link to Jaeger traces and Loki logs with pre-filled query
Jules: important: make the golden signals panels 160px high each and include a small legend for region colors. include alerts overlay so we can see which alerts were firing when.
Omar: some query ideas (PromQL) for Grafana panels:
```
# 5xx rate (global)
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="runtime",status=~"5.."}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="runtime"}[1m]))

# backend active connections per proxy pool
sum(runtime_proxy_active_conns{pool!~"internal.*"}) by (pool,region)
```
Sree: for the noise-meter panel we'll use a Prometheus counter metric `alertmanager_alerts_fired_total` and a Grafana table transform to show top rules. also add a simple scorecard that computes alerts-per-day-per-service to track noise trend.
Hana: drilldown wiring: panel link should populate Jaeger with `service=runtime` and `min_duration=50ms` and Loki with labels `job=runtime` and `level=error` plus a time range based on zoom. include template variables for region and model.
QA-bot: add a test for the new alert rule: synthetic scenario that increases error rate to 1.2% for 6m and verify the rule fires only after 3m and pages the augmentation channel first.
Jules: owners and next steps: Omar -> infra change PR + canary of new alert suppression logic, Sree -> Grafana dashboard PR, Hana -> update runbook with new thresholds & partner throttling play, QA-bot -> test harness for alert rule. target: PRs in 4 business days.
Omar: I'll land an infra PR that adds `ondeploy` and `ondegradation` annotations to alert manager and a new mute window tied to deploy-bot events. will also add the augmentation-channel routing for rules marked `test_stage=true`.
Sree: dashboard prototype ETA 48h, will include snapshot links and JSON model for review.
Hana: runbook change: create a quick checklist for partner spikes (1) check partner quotas, (2) throttle, (3) extend timeouts, (4) escalate to partner ops.
Jules: customer impact: a handful of customers using that webhook partner saw retries; we sent targeted notification, no SLO breach. include statement in postmortem.
Jules: will open the incident retro doc and link the dashboard PR when available. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
